chosen_material_event_history.physical_story: A ready liquid undergoes a main flow supported by a continuous carrier stream and, in IT37, separate unmarked and pulsed instrumental flows. A later material state names pure flow-capable liquid, followed by another actual main flow with a mentioned mouth. The later liquid is described with purification-result G or purification-purpose I. The later pulsed and unmarked instruments modify that latter flow retrospectively. No extra lexical process, filtration or mixing operation is decoded.

chosen_material_event_history.same_vs_different: H38 and H40 are different main episodes in this parse, because THEN39/THEN40 create intervening state and renewed episode choices. E_cont38/E_pulse38 are different instrumental flow events over the same i38, not one contradictory event; materials are distinct parcels/streams although related to one fluid system. E_unmarked38 is a third distinct instrumental episode. E_pulse40 and E_unmarked40 are distinct from each other and from H40. No coidentity inferred merely from repeated forms.
physical_scope_consequences: E_cont38 cannot stop before chosen THEN39 boundary.

E_pulse38 must stop internally even while the separate carrier E_cont38 does not. This requires distinct concurrent flow streams/paths or parcels, an unexpressed physical arrangement; the text does not identify it.

If every37 flow mention is forced by independent evidence to one same event/material/phase, current IT package is contradicted. ZL does not write the two new37 instrument wholes and does not independently corroborate this multi-stream claim.
Instrumental flows are actual; neither main flow must be completed, and no flow operation by itself entails purification or mixing.

G LCHEDY states prior purification result; its causal agent/event is unexpressed and not equated automatically to H38/H40. I LCHEDY is purpose only. Explicit CHEDY PURE is kept as separately written state.
